findings.problem: Systemic term drift: the patch set renders "provider" as "प्रदाता" (21 values across tui.analytics, tui.app, cli.login*/logout/global_help, wire.errors.auth/media, wire.settings.account_policy), while every shipped hi catalogue uses "प्रोवाइडर" (41 values, e.g. wire.settings). One concept would have two names in the same product.
findings.suggested: "प्रोवाइडर के अनुसार" here and in table.by_provider; replace प्रदाता→प्रोवाइडर (with inflection) in all 21 values

findings.problem: Meaning preserved (free out of priced; money paid). 'मूल्य-वाले' is hyphenated and stiff; 'कीमत वाले' is more natural.

findings.problem: Meaning preserved (decode rate over {shown} of {total} calls). '(कुल {total})' is fine, but '(कुल {total} में से)' says outright that {shown} is a subset and keeps the argument order.
findings.suggested: decode दर {shown, number} कॉल पर (कुल {total, number} में से)
